fix(editor): keep viewport zoom when keyboard text editing starts (#195)

Wrapping the canvas in PopScope only after an external edit session
starts remounted PlateEditor and re-fit the template to the default
size. Keep PopScope in the tree so adding text no longer resets pinch
zoom.
